text:
payments-bot: Alert: automatic charge failed for INV-6789 (Nimbus AI) - decline code: card_declined. Attempt 1.

ana_finance: Noted — enterprise renewal. I pinged billing contact earlier, no reply.

leo_support: Customer replied on the ticket: says their card was flagged for fraud and they'll send a wire today. Asked for wire instructions and whether we can provision while transfer is pending.

ana_finance: We can accept wire but per policy we don't mark invoices paid until funds clear. Pause auto-dunning and auto-cancel for 72h. @mike_accounting can you pause notices and flag invoice as "pending - wire"?

mike_accounting: Pausing dunning for 72h and setting invoice flag to pending_wire. When bank confirmation arrives (txn id + amount + posted date) paste it here and I'll reconcile. If sales approves, we can provision temporarily.

viv_sales: AM said treasury will initiate wire today if we send instructions. They also asked for a beneficiary verification doc — will need legal name + address.

ana_finance: Wire template below (mask account digits). Ask them to include INV-6789 in the payment reference and to CC accounting when they send confirmation.

```
Bank: Northbridge Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account number: ****3344
Routing/ABA: 666000777
SWIFT/BIC: NBUSXXXX
Reference/Memo: INV-6789
Amount: USD 210,000.00
```

leo_support: Sent template to customer at 10:12 PT and asked them to reply to this thread with the bank confirmation when initiated. Included invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-6789

viv_sales: I'll get the beneficiary verification document and attach here for their treasury. Also please confirm provisional provisioning policy so AM can sign off.

ana_finance: I'll schedule one automatic card retry in 36h in case they resolve the card issue. If wire confirmation arrives before retry I'll cancel it.

payments-bot: Scheduled retry set for 1749034834 (36h).

mike_accounting: When the wire posts, paste the bank's deposit confirmation (txn id, amount, posted date) and I'll apply the payment. If they send a partial amount, AM must approve applying partial credit.

leo_support: customer replied: "wire initiated, bank gave trace 9988776655, expected settlement 2 business days" — forwarded their email (redacted).

mike_accounting: Received. Once settlement posts, paste the bank confirmation screenshot or text and I'll reconcile.

viv_sales: AM confirmed provisional provisioning is OK once wire is initiated and treasury email is in thread. I'll cc accounting on the confirmation email.

ana_finance: Thanks team — keeping this thread open until payment applied. If wire fails or we don't receive confirmation by EOD +3 escalate to collections. :white_check_mark:
